Hi Priya / Daniel —

Quick intro: Lightfoot Health is evaluating Redwood for low-latency hosted inference for their care coordination product. Daniel, thanks again for the thoughtful discovery call last week — we scoped the key success criteria and an initial MLP.

Priya — we would love an AWS seller intro and to align on co-sell motion. Proposed ask: a 30-minute warm intro between AWS seller, Lightfoot procurement/tech lead (Daniel), and our R&D + CS leads to run a short mutual action plan (MAP) and clarify procurement path.

Draft MAP (attached as spreadsheet):
- Week 0: Intro + alignment (this call) — confirm security gate owners and procurement timeline
- Week 1–2: Technical deep-dive + trial plan (SE + dev sandbox)
- Week 3–4: Pilot/POC evaluation with perf targets (latency p95 < 200ms for 512 tokens)
- Week 5: Procurement & contract negotiation cadence (Redwood Dedicated or Hosted)

Attachments: Lightfoot_MAP_v1.xlsx, redwood-aws-co-sell-deck.pdf

Suggested times (PDT): Tue 8/18 10:00–10:30, Tue 8/18 14:00–14:30, Wed 8/19 11:00–11:30. Priya — can you confirm which seller should own the co-sell and whether AWS needs a specific intake form?

Kimberly & Connor — can you both join the intro? I’ll include Marcus from CS once we have a confirmed slot.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
